verse.verse_1: Have you seen him who denies the Recompense?
verse.verse_2: That is he who repulses the orphan (harshly),
verse.verse_3: And urges not the feeding of AlMiskin (the poor),
verse.verse_4: So woe unto those performers of Salat (prayers) (hypocrites),
verse.verse_5: Who delay their Salat (prayer) from their stated fixed times,
verse.verse_6: Those who do good deeds only to be seen (of men),
verse.verse_7: And refuse Al-Ma'un (small kindnesses e.g. salt, sugar, water, etc.).
